newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle sell $106/dressed, up $2-trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle sell $106/dressed, up $2-trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sold at $106.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, up $2.00 from the bulk of last week's sales, market sources there said.
About 20,000 to 30,000 head sold near midday Wednesday in active trading, with the total expected to climb as the day progresses, they said.
Remaining cattle were priced by owners at $106.00 to $107.00, the sources said. Sales on a live basis were reported at $65.00 to $66.00.
Gains were tied to firming beef prices and the ability of feedlots to remain current in their marketings, they said.
